name: AskNest
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Multilingual FAQ bot for the Shopify storefront that answers from your own FAQs, policy pages and product catalogue in seven languages, with product recommendations and best sellers. Launched May 2026 with a single App Store review.
best_for: small stores with repetitive product, shipping and returns questions who want a cheap multilingual FAQ widget and can test the answer quality on their own policy pages for free first
skip_if: you need human handover or ticketing, you sell in languages outside the seven supported, or you want a vendor with more than one review and more than one app behind it
honest_knock:
One review. The app launched on 8 May 2026, and in three and a half months exactly one merchant has written about it. That is five stars, 16 July 2026, from an Austrian store, and it is about support responsiveness: they wanted the widget's language changed and someone called Tracy did it within minutes. That is a pleasant data point about the vendor and no data point at all about whether the bot answers correctly under load.

The developer is a Shopify agency, not a support-software company. Ecommerce Storez sells Shopify themes, store builds and SEO audits from ecommercestorez.us, and AskNest is one of two apps it has shipped in 2026 — the other, AgentNest, has no reviews. AskNest has no product site of its own; the App Store listing is the entire published record, which is why the link we point at is the developer's agency site.

And be clear about what this is not. There is no live human takeover on any tier, no ticketing, no inbox. It reads your FAQs, your policy pages and your catalogue and answers from them in seven languages. When a shopper asks something your policy pages do not cover, nothing on the listing describes what happens next — no handover to email, no escalation. For a first line of defence on repetitive questions that is fine and five dollars is a fair price for it. As your only support channel it is not enough.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 500 AI replies with automatic shopper-language detection…
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/asknest-ai-faq-product-bot, re-verified unchanged 2026-09-28) Four tiers, priced by AI replies per month, and the cheapest ladder in this category. Free: 50 AI replies a month, replies in one language you select, answers drawn from your FAQs, policy pages and product data, translated storefront widget, product finder and usage tracking. Starter $4.99 a month: 500 replies, automatic shopper-language detection across up to three languages, translated replies, product recommendations and best sellers. Growth $9.99 a month: 1,500 replies and all supported languages. Pro $19.99 a month: 5,000 replies. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial. What the listing never says is what happens when you run out: there is no overage rate anywhere on the page, so whether reply 501 costs money or simply does not happen is not published. 'Any language' is also not on offer; customer-facing replies and widget labels cover English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese — seven. Developer Ecommerce Storez, 1255 23rd St NW, Washington DC; the app launched 8 May 2026 and has exactly one App Store review.
